snippet.title: Build Your Own GPU -  IT THINKS! - Demo is ready on Steam
snippet.description:
Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

Play IT THINKS! demo on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5196330/IT_THINKS__Build_Your_Own_GPU
